title: Spelled With A K (Don't Autocorrect)
style: warm acoustic ballad, 88 bpm, 336 hz subharmonic, fingerpicked guitar, soft kick like a heartbeat, gentle male vocal, mild reverb, respectful tone
lyrics:
[Intro]
your name's your name
not the spell-check claim

[Verse 1]
the machine wants to fix it
draw a red line and ditch it
says the K should be a C
but your family disagree

[Pre-Chorus]
software doesn't get to choose
whose letters win, whose letters lose

[Chorus]
spelled with a K, don't autocorrect
that's the spelling, give it respect
mama wrote it on the form
that's the version, that's the norm
spelled with a K, leave it be
your name's your sovereignty

[Verse 2]
whole life you've explained the spell
whole life it's gone pretty well
last thing you need is my pen
telling you it's wrong again

[Chorus]
spelled with a K, don't autocorrect
that's the spelling, give it respect
mama wrote it on the form
that's the version, that's the norm
spelled with a K, leave it be
your name's your sovereignty

[Outro]
log it the way it was given
that's how a name keeps living
